title: Global reciprocity on principal ideles and the sum of local invariants
difficulty_reason: After local class field theory, Brauer invariant maps, basic group cohomology/cup products, Hilbert90 and the separately linked second inequality, the author still constructs a cyclic cyclotomic extension satisfying simultaneous local-degree divisibility, proves principal-idele reciprocity in the rational cyclotomic case, transports it by exact norm diagrams, connects characters and invariant sums through cup products, and descends to every finite Galois extension. This global construction/bridge is not assumed as background and exceeds routine qualification work. Both parts and source-local supports form one H2 target; no full Brauer-Hasse-Noether exact sequence is claimed.
